  • Detail‑oriented with strong written reasoning and communication skills.
  • Self‑motivated and reliable when working independently.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or CISM.
  • Background in information security, internal audit, or enterprise risk management.

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside top research labs.
  • Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global community of experts.
  • Contribute to meaningful work that advances AI understanding of real‑world security and compliance.
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension.

  • Solid understanding of disruption types: delays, shortages, quality issues, and logistics challenges.
  • Knowledge of Incoterms and transportation/logistics management.
  • Familiarity with BOM structures and production planning processes.
  • Experience with supplier performance metrics (OTIF, lead times, quality scores).
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess AI outputs against real‑world business logic.
  • Experience with data validation, structured data entry, or annotation tasks.
  • Clear written communication in English.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

Job Description

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide. As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development. You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design. Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To Succeed In This Role, You Typically Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom‑designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field—from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea. Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

Basic Function

The Red Carpet Coordinator is responsible for managing the operational workflow of the Red Carpet and Rapid ART processes to ensure newly diagnosed and re‑engaged patients are linked to HIV medical care within 72 hours. This role focuses on referral coordination, patient navigation, clinic flow support, and data tracking to promote same‑day access to antiretroviral therapy (ART), retention in care, and viral suppression outcomes. The position supports daily clinic readiness, patient outreach, and grant‑related administrative functions in alignment with quality management and funding requirements.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third‑party payers, medical organizations, patients, and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinate same‑day or expedited medical appointments, laboratory services, and provider consultations.
  • Facilitate timely initiation of ART in collaboration with providers, pharmacies, and laboratories.
  • Track linkage to care within 72 hours and document services in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Monitor retention and viral suppression indicators to support continuity of care.
  • Communicate with interdisciplinary team members to ensure seamless transitions into care.
  • Receive, process, and track internal and external referrals for HIV primary care and Rapid ART services.
  • Monitor referral outcomes and conduct follow‑up on incomplete, missed, or delayed appointments.
  • Conduct outreach calls to support re‑engagement efforts and reduce gaps in care.
  • Identify and elevate barriers to care (e.g., transportation, insurance status, medication access) to appropriate team members.
  • Coordinate warm handoffs to internal departments and community‑based support services.
  • Prepare clinic areas daily to ensure operational readiness, including exam room preparation and supply inventory monitoring.
  • Provide patient check‑in and check‑out support as needed; serve as backup to front desk staff.
  • Conduct appointment reminder calls, lab reminders, and follow‑up communications.
  • Support medication refill coordination by processing refill requests and communicating with providers and pharmacies.
  • Assist with patient flow and triage by identifying urgent concerns and notifying licensed clinical staff appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation of coordination activities in the EMR.
  • Support infection control practices and clinic safety procedures.
  • Track and report referral‑related performance measures, including linkage to care, retention in care, and viral suppression.
  • Maintain tracking logs and data systems related to Rapid ART and Red Carpet initiatives.
  • Support quality management initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Assist with grant administrative tasks, documentation, and reporting requirements to ensure compliance with funding benchmarks.
  • Generate reports and maintain supporting documentation for audits and program monitoring.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of HIV treatment models, Rapid ART workflows, and linkage‑to‑care best practices preferred.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality regulations.
  • Ability to manage time‑sensitive workflows and prioritize urgent linkage activities.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills to monitor performance measures.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with patients from diverse backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated cultural competence and commitment to health equity.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in healthcare, public health, case coordination, or clinic operations preferred.
  • Experience in HIV care or infectious disease settings strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical record (EMR) systems required.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification preferred or obtained within organizational timeframe (if required by organization).

Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000–$45,000

The primary role is to provide technical expertise pertaining to the development, launching, and assessment of various maintenance programs, processes, procedures and best practices for Global Manufacturing facilities.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop maintenance processes, maintenance management strategy, work and performance management strategy and conduct Maintenance health assessment in line with GME and corporate requirements. This includes PM and PdM strategies, Organization structures, manpower analysis, cost analysis, etc., and appraise and prepare reports on the effectiveness of such processes.
  • Conduct data driven analyses to benchmark maintenance organization’s performance to identify gaps and set sustainable plan to close the gaps. This includes, but not limited to: Spending Analysis, Maintenance Effectiveness, operating costs of existing assets, PM, and PdM, Wrench time analysis, SAP Taxonomy, Planning & Scheduling, Personnel Competency, Budgeting Strategy, Bad Actors, and RAM Modeling.
  • Analyze facilities’ maintenance performance to establish reference baseline & issue frequent maintenance benchmarking reports to promote knowledge.
  • Review maintenance reporting mechanism and KPIs along with their trends to drive performance and provide recommendations accordingly.
  • Analyze maintenance spending in terms of manpower, equipment, materials procurement and outsource strategies.
  • Assist the line maintenance organizations in the implementation of approved programs such as TPRM or GM reliability model.
  • Develop methods and programs for handling new situations in maintenance fields. This will include prototype pumps, motors, compressors, turbines, valves, instrument systems and computer systems.
  • Design, in conjunction with engineering personnel and vendor representatives, alternative parts or systems.
  • Represent AMSD on standing Committees, Special Task Groups or Ad Hoc Committees.
  • Recommend work which can be economically assigned to contractor organizations and develops scope of work.

Qualifications

  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas downstream Sector.
  • You will be able to demonstrate high degree of technical competence in the area of maintenance programs and practices.
  • You will have experience with risk-based processes such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance & Risk Based Maintenance
  • You will have experience with TotalProductive Maintenance
  • You must have strong hands-on experience with Spare Parts and Materials procurement strategies
  • You will have Best-in-class Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Work Prioritization experience
  • You must have strong Experience with Maintenance budgeting and spending control methodologies.
  • You will have Experience in field maintenance methodologies, processes, and procedures.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with CMMS such as SAP

Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems

(Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting)

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior-level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Full stack or backend development
  • Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems
  • Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency
  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software.

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios
  • Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software, Systems, or Engineering disciplines, or Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features
  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • This job posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams.
  • Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs)
  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment.
  • Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process.

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

Reminder

Applicants must select their technical track as part of the application process so they can be considered for the appropriate role covered by this posting.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua. Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável. Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto. Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems

Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior‑level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Full stack or backend development
  • Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems
  • Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency
  • Cost‑aware architectural decisions
  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software.

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios
  • Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software, systems, engineering disciplines, data science, mathematics, physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features
  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs)
  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar a gestão de documentos e arquivos, elaborar relatórios e planilhas para análise de dados, apoiar atividades administrativas e facilitar a comunicação entre departamentos. Contribuir para a implementação de políticas administrativas, atender demandas internas e externas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas ou Hospitalar ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos. Pós-graduação na área de atuação. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform — open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide — including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole — Kestra orchestrates mission‑critical workloads at scale. The open‑source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast‑growing global community. In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo – backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face.

The Role

We’re looking for a QA Engineer based in Brazil to ensure the quality and reliability of Kestra’s platform across both the open‑source and Enterprise editions. A key part of this role involves working directly with customer support tickets: understanding reported issues, reproducing them in local or staging environments, and verifying fixes before they ship. You’ll be the bridge between what customers experience and what the engineering team delivers. This is a fully remote position. We’re hiring from Brazil for timezone alignment with the broader team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and analyze customer support tickets to understand reported issues, extract reproduction steps, and translate customer‑reported problems into actionable bug reports for the engineering team.
  • Reproduce customer‑reported bugs across different environments and configurations, ensuring the engineering team has the context they need to fix issues efficiently.
  • Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases covering both the open‑source platform and Enterprise Edition features.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing for new features and regression testing for existing functionality across each release cycle.
  • Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and validate fixes before release.
  • Contribute to building and improving automated test coverage where applicable.
  • Track and report on quality metrics, test coverage, and recurring issue patterns to help the team prioritize improvements.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in software QA with a strong foundation in both manual and automated testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret customer support tickets, often with incomplete information, and systematically reproduce issues. This is central to the role.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and orchestration concepts: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow automation tools. You’ll need this context to test effectively.
  • Comfortable working with APIs, reading logs, and navigating distributed systems to trace issues.
  • Experience writing automated tests (for instance, in Java, Python, or TypeScript) and working with test frameworks.
  • Strong written communication in English. You’ll collaborate with a globally distributed team and document issues clearly.
  • Self‑directed and detail‑oriented. You can prioritize across incoming support issues and planned test cycles without heavy oversight.

Bonus Points

  • Past experience in a QA role that involved direct interaction with customer‑reported issues or support escalations.
  • Experience with open‑source software or B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with orchestration or workflow tools (Airflow, n8n, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of Java (Kestra’s core is written in Java).

What You Get

  • Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.
  • A product used for mission‑critical workloads — not demos.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance.

What’s The Role
The Orca Development is a Shell-operated ultra-deepwater Flagship Project located in the prolific pre-salt Santos basin offshore Brazil. The field will be developed with 12 subsea wells tied back to a new building Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) unit. The FPSO will be in water depths of 2000m, roughly 200km south of Rio de Janeiro.
While Shell is a major producer in Brazil, Orca is critical to extend Shell-operated production into the 2030s. The project will leverage the experience of the FPSO Contractor to supply and operate the FPSO. The FPSO Contractor is one of the foremost suppliers of FPSOs in the world and currently operates more than a dozen FPSOs in Brazil. The FPSO Contractor Detailed Engineering, Procurement and Project Management is centered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, while construction is spread across multiple construction yards in China and Japan, while Installation and Commissioning will be performed offshore Brazil.
Orca contracting is focused on the selection of Tier 1 Contractors to maximize delivery confidence for the FPSO, Subsea Hardware (SSHW) and Umbilical Riser & Flowline (URF) contracts. The project employs a lean Owner’s Team with the delivery know-how and commercial acumen to effectively balance “letting the contractor deliver in an area where they are experts” while maintaining expert oversight over critical delivery components of the project to deliver a world class operating asset safely, on time and on budget. Hence, team members must demonstrate the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with Contractors; to implement scaled assurance processes to manage design and execution risks in a pragmatic way; to adapt Shell processes to industry driven solutions while maintaining system integrity and performance; and to work across system and discipline boundaries for best for project solutions.

Accountabilities

  • Interface with project disciplines & contractors to ensure the schedule is fully integrated.

  • 10+ years of experience in planning/scheduling within complex capital projects, acquired preferably in major oil & gas offshore installation projects

  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (mandatory) and MS Project
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including:
  • Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) development
  • Critical Path Method (CPM)
  • Progress measurement systems
  • Earned Value Management (EVM)
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering documents, procurement plans and construction sequences
  • Experience with data analytics and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

  • Ability to influence without authority and facilitate cross-functional alignment.
  • Proactive, adaptable and oriented to solutions.

You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths. We are #EnergizedByGrowth. DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations. Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Talent Acquisition, development & mobility
    • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
    • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
    • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
    • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Performance management & organizational development
    • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
    • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
    • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

These values are part of our DNA; they are the principles that guide everything that we do.

Role Purpose

As the Manager of Financial Statement Review, you will lead a team dedicated to review, optimization, and support of financial statement preparation for fund clients and ad-hoc structures. Your responsibilities include ensuring high standards of service delivery, compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP), and effective client management. This role emphasizes expertise in financial review, process improvement, technology utilization, cross-department collaboration, and innovation.

Responsibilities (high-level)

  • People Management Responsibilities.
  • Financial Statement Preparation and Management
  • Process Development and Technology Optimization
  • Operational Efficiency and Innovation:
  • Client Service and Support
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration
  • Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

1. People Management Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

  • a) Team Management - Manage the company’s global technology and product teams and ensure that all team members have relevant Job Descriptions that include Tasks and KPIs.
  • b) Day-to-day Team management – Managing the team on a day-to-day basis by implementing:
  • Weekly task management
  • Weekly team meetings

c)Team Satisfaction - Monitoring the team's capacity and ensuring high-level satisfaction and work-life balance.

d) Feedback and Coaching - Providing feedback and coaching to the team members with the aim of constantly improving their performance.

e) Team Training - Coordinating and providing training and development programs within the technology and product teams as or when required.

f) Team Succession planning - Identifying any high-potential and high-risk employees and developing the relevant succession plans.

2. Financial Statement Review and Oversight:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Review and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of financial statements prepared by the Financial Preparation team, ensuring accuracy, compliance with accounting standards, and high-quality presentation.

b) Process Accountability: Take ownership of the financial statement review cycle and be accountable for adherence to deadlines, service levels, and client expectations.

c) Complex Structures: Support and review the preparation of statements for complex fund structures, addressing intricate financial and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Development and Technology Optimization:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Process Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance financial statement processes through automation and system integration, minimizing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency.

b) System Utilization: Collaborate with technology and operations teams to optimize existing systems and identify new tools to streamline data transformation for financial statements.

c) Innovation Implementation: Drive the adoption of scalable processes, leveraging technology and best practices to ensure compliance and efficiency.

4. Operational Efficiency and Innovation:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Workflow Enhancement: Develop, implement, and refine workflows to support seamless financial statement review and improve productivity.

b) Scalability Focus: Identify opportunities to expand and scale financial statement support services to meet client needs and market demands.

c)New Solutions: Collaborate with product teams to design and introduce new services tailored to changing client needs and market conditions.

5. Client Service and Support:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the main point of contact for clients utilizing the Financial Statement Review Service, addressing their needs with professionalism and insight.

b) Client Engagement: Build and maintain client relationships, proactively managing expectations, service requests, and bespoke solutions.

c) Industry Adaptation: Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging practices to continuously adapt and enhance service offerings.

6. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

  • Work cross-functionally with operations, business users, and project teams to deliver comprehensive and innovative solutions.
  • Drive process integration across service lines to ensure consistent, high-quality client service delivery and effective resource utilization.

7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory requirements, and jurisdictional changes affecting entities reporting under IFRS or US GAAP.

b) Act as the primary contact for all client interactions with external auditors, ensuring comprehensive, accurate, and timely responses.

c) Support new fund onboarding by ensuring smooth integration into financial statement workflows and compliance standards.

d) Policy Implementation: Help implement compliance policies at the operational level.

Performance & Cost Optimization

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend (Brazil)
description:
About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that’s revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest‑growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth‑stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote‑first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUP has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long‑term stability.

About The Role

CharterUP is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Backend to design, build, and operate the APIs and backend systems that power our mobile experience for a two‑sided marketplace. This role will work closely with our Brazil‑based mobile team, as well as U.S.-based engineering, product, and design partners, to deliver reliable, scalable services that enable high‑quality user experiences. You’ll focus on backend service development, API design, and system reliability, helping ensure our mobile applications are fast, resilient, and able to scale with our growing business.

Title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs for mobile applications, using modern and AI‑assisted development practices.
  • Partner with mobile engineers to define API contracts and deliver seamless, high‑performance user experiences.
  • Own service reliability, scalability, and performance, including deployment, monitoring, and optimization in AWS.
  • Drive backend best practices across testing, observability, and operational efficiency, leveraging AI‑driven tooling where appropriate.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to deliver high‑impact features and identify opportunities to improve systems and workflows through AI.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience as a backend or full‑stack engineer with a strong backend focus.
  • Proficiency in JVM‑based languages (Java, Kotlin, etc.) and experience building scalable RESTful APIs.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, and backend performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS) and modern deployment practices, with exposure to AI‑assisted tools for development, monitoring, or automation.
  • Strong ownership mindset and collaboration skills, with experience working closely with mobile or frontend teams in cross‑functional environments.
  • Familiarity with the Backend‑for‑Frontend (BFF) pattern, including designing and maintaining mobile‑optimized APIs that aggregate and tailor data for specific client use cases, improving performance and reducing client complexity.

Compensation

  • Estimated monthly rate: $6,000 – $7,000 USD

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

  • Remote‑First Flexibility: Work from anywhere we hire, with built‑in flexibility. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family‑building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company‑paid life, short‑term, and long‑term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast‑moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long‑term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region‑specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top‑Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming. We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

Salário

A combinar

Descrição da posição

O Técnico de Enfermagem exerce atividades relacionadas aos cuidados de enfermagem de média e pequena complexidade, auxiliando a equipe de saúde na execução dos trabalhos em nível hospitalar, com foco no cumprimento da prescrição de enfermagem.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como: prestar assistência aos pacientes através de cuidados de higienização, auxílio à alimentação, verificação de glicemia capilar, terapias de suporte respiratório (micro e macro nebulização), aspiração de vias aéreas, manipulação de sondas e drenos, limpeza e desinfecção de materiais, preparação de corpos pós‑morte, assistência contínua aos pacientes em cuidados no fim da vida e sedação controlada, administração de medicamentos via oral, endovenoso, intramuscular e subcutâneo, observando horários e posologia conforme a prescrição médica, a fim de obter o equilíbrio clínico dos pacientes.
  • Receber e passar plantão junto à equipe de enfermagem, tomando e/ou dando ciência de todas as anormalidades e eventuais ocorrências no período, garantindo comunicação efetiva para continuidade do cuidado.
  • Coletar materiais para análise laboratorial, identificando‑os e encaminhá‑los aos laboratórios específicos, a fim de que sejam efetuadas as devidas análises.
  • Controlar e/ou efetuar desinfecção de materiais utilizados nos procedimentos, utilizando técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção.
  • Participar de treinamentos em serviço, garantindo a atualização científica na área, assegurando a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem e a segurança do paciente.
  • Realizar limpeza de utensílios de banho (comadres, patinhos, balde, jarra, bacias) e de terapia respiratória, enviados para reprocessamento, com técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela CCIH, registrando e informando dados para minimizar riscos de transmissão de infecção.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Qualificação : Formação Técnica em Enfermagem; Desejável experiência na função.
  • Conhecimentos : Administração de medicamentos; Saúde do Idoso.
  • Habilidades : Organização; Concentração; Relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Atitudes : Disponibilidade; Empatia; Comprometimento.

  • Vagas Diurnas e Noturnas.
  • Salário Insalubridade.
  • Plano de Saúde.
  • Plano Odontológico.

title: TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONAL SAE - AP 4.0
description:
Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;
  • Pós Graduação e/ou Especialização na area de reabilitação.

Informações adicionais

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

title: Eletricista
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e estruturais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado e seguro dos equipamentos e instalações.
  • Diagnosticar e reparar falhas e defeitos em sistemas elétricos, como painéis, fios, tomadas e interruptores, além de sistemas mecânicos e hidráulicos conforme necessário.
  • Executar a instalação e substituição de componentes elétricos e mecânicos, como motores, circuitos e dispositivos de controle.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nos sistemas e equipamentos para identificar e corrigir possíveis problemas antes que se tornem críticos.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos, diagramas e manuais técnicos para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo as peças substituídas e os problemas encontrados.
  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulamentos aplicáveis, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e técnicas seguras.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe e supervisores para garantir a eficiência e a qualidade na execução das atividades.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter informado sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.
  • Responder a chamadas de emergência e realizar reparos urgentes para minimizar o tempo de inatividade e garantir a continuidade das operações.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico na área de elétrica, mecânica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção elétrica, mecânica e estrutural, com conhecimento em diagnóstico e reparo de falhas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e hidráulicos, incluindo leitura de esquemas e diagramas.
  • Certificações e treinamentos específicos na área de manutenção (desejável).
  • Experiência com ferramentas e equipamentos de manutenção.

  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.

Competências Técnicas

description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Executar reparos em geral nas dependências da empresa, incluindo serviços de pintura, alvenaria, gesso e piso, bem como a manutenção periódica da rede hidráulica do condomínio. Executar operações básicas no sistema de refrigeração como Parametrizações, Operações e Manobras em tubulações de Ar Condicionado, Operar Bombas, Compressores, Fancoils, Torre de Refrigeração, assim como realizar atividades básicas de manutenção autonoma, como Limpeza da Torre, trocas de filtro, trocas e reposição de óleo e verificação de funcionamento de instrumentos. O Oficial de Manutenção é responsável pela pintura de tubulações, grades, portões, pilares, piso, teto e paredes em geral, executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva no sistema hidráulico, inspeções rotineiras em bombas hidráulicas e banheiros, a fim de garantir seu perfeito funcionamento, identificar e promover reparos em telhados, organizar a oficina de trabalho.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

  • Executar trabalhos de pintura e retoques em todas as dependências do shopping, com tinta PVA, esmalte, epoxi ou acrílica nas áreas que necessitem.
  • Realizar pinturas em mesas, cadeiras, armários, portas e janelas, onde tal necessite.
  • Realizar preparo de superfícies (lixamento, aplicação de massa plástica, gesso, etc) antes de realizar pintura final.
  • Executar de serviços e reparos em alvenaria, gesso em todas as dependências do condomínio, incluindo em paredes, pilares, pisos, calçadas e forros, visando apoiar a realização das atividades de manutenção civil no empreendimento.
  • Realizar demolições de pequeno porte. Garantir correta remoção do entulho da obras.
  • Confeccionar alçapões, paredes e caixas de concreto.
  • Revisar periodicamente os reservatórios de água e poços artesianos, incluindo rede hidráulica e medidores de consumo.
  • Vistoriar periodicamente a rede hidráulica dos sanitários; casa de bombas, bebedouros, mictórios, vasos sanitários, sifões, válvulas de descarga e acessórios.
  • Trocar válvulas, torneiras, sifões sempre que necessário e limpeza nas caixas sanfonadas.
  • Desentupir a rede de esgoto, vasos sanitários (com retirada e recolocação) sempre que necessário. Realizar limpeza de rede principal de esgoto do mall e áreas técnicas.
  • Realizar reparos nas instalações quando houver ocorrências de vazamento. Manutenção em tubulações de PVC, aço carbono, ferro fundido e cobre (SPK, hidrante, água potável e gás).
  • Controlar rede de sprinklers, despressurizando e pressurizando quando necessário, assim como Executar soldas do tipo mig, tig, convencional, oxiacetileno e estanho.
  • Apoio nas atividades gerais da área e manutenção (sinalização de áreas, fornecer papel para vitrines de lojas, apoio a jardinagem e a equipe da limpeza, montagem de tapumes e outros).
  • Manter limpo e organizado a área de trabalho, na oficina de manutenção, nos depósitos e corredores Técnicos.
  • Operar os equipamentos de ar condicionado realizando ronda para verificar as áreas técnicas, verificar o livro de ocorrências, partir e desligar máquinas. Executar reparos e ajustes operacionais necessários.
  • Verificar nível de água das torres, verificar nível de água do reservatório e sistema de tratamento e boias de nível.
  • Verificar o funcionamento das bombas, verificar nível de óleo dos equipamentos.
  • Realizar limpeza das torres de refrigeração.
  • Realizar troca e limpeza de filtros de fancoils, filtros de bebedouros, filtros de sistema de ventilação e exaustão.
  • Monitorar o sistema por leitura de instrumentos e alarmes como dados de temperatura externa, temperatura da água gelada, umidade do ar, temperatura de bulbo úmido.
  • Atender chamados de clientes/lojistas a fim de detectar o problema de sistemas hidráulicos e climatização e corrigir, se possível. Caso contrário dar as devidas orientações para o lojista chamar a sua própria equipe de manutenção.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a BSL Saúde, a maior rede de cuidados pós-agudos do Brasil e atuamos com Residenciais para Idosos, Clínicas de Transição e Home Care. Somos especialistas em cuidados humanizados e contamos com equipes de saúde multidisciplinares.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Garantir a eficácia da dispensação de medicamentos aos residentes através da gestão de equipe e do desenvolvimento e aplicação de técnicas seguras, ligadas ao plano assistencial e econômico da Instituição.
  • Definir, padronizar e controlar os materiais médicos e medicamentos a serem utilizados na unidade, com o mapeamento dos itens utilizados, participando da comissão e sugerindo novos materiais visando o escopo técnico e financeiro.
  • Organizar e acompanhar as atividades e rotinas junto aos processos de farmácia garantindo a continuidade das operações.
  • Responder pela logística de distribuição de medicamentos e materiais da unidade, acompanhando seu armazenamento, distribuição, transporte até a dispensação e administração, assegurando o manejo adequado dos medicamentos.
  • Supervisionar rotinas de conferência, armazenamento, controle de estoque, separação, individualização e distribuição de medicamentos. Verificar medicamentos vencidos e sua destinação.
  • Verificar periodicamente o estoque de medicamentos e materiais, solicitando ao setor de compras quando necessário para garantir abastecimento seguro e contínuo aos residentes.
  • Garantir os procedimentos de dispensação e separação de medicamentos com o acompanhamento garantindo a correta liberação.
  • Controlar estoque e recebimento de notas fiscais de compra dos medicamentos e materiais, bem como o prazo de entrega das notas ao departamento fiscal da empresa.

  • Verificar interações medicamentosas e possíveis reações, e discutir com equipe médica quando necessária alteração.

  • Dar suporte técnico aos auxiliares, bem como a equipe multidisciplinar, instruindo sobre medicamento e correlatos.

Somos a maior fabricante de equipamentos de videocirurgia do Brasil com matriz e fábrica no Rio de Janeiro, escritório em São Paulo e representação comercial em todo o país. Com 21 anos de história, já instalamos mais de 10.000 equipamentos em todas as regiões do Brasil, conquistando a confiança de nossos clientes e levando cada vez mais inovação, segurança e qualidade para o mercado de saúde.

Temos muito orgulho em ser uma indústria nacional, com desenvolvimento tecnológico próprio, baseado em inovação e compromisso com cirurgiões, com a comunidade de pesquisa médica e, principalmente, com os pacientes, os maiores beneficiários de nossos esforços diários.

Nosso Sonho Grande (propósito) é Acabar com a Cicatriz da Cirurgia Aberta. A Habitat Consultórios é uma plataforma inovadora que conecta profissionais de saúde a espaços de atendimento, otimizando a utilização de consultórios e melhorando a experiência de profissionais e pacientes. A Habitat não é apenas um espaço de saúde; é uma experiência. Somos uma empresa dedicada a oferecer serviços de saúde de alta qualidade, onde a excelência no atendimento e a inovação se encontram. Aqui, cada detalhe é pensado para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Nossa cultura prioriza o relacionamento humano, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a adaptação às novidades do mercado. Se você é uma pessoa que busca impactar positivamente a vida dos outros e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e empenhada, você pertence à Habitat!

Cultura da Habitat

Valorizamos a proatividade, a excelência no atendimento e a capacidade de adaptar‑se e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico. Nossos colaboradores são incentivados a desenvolver suas habilidades e a buscar novas oportunidades de crescimento dentro da organização.

Atividades

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber pacientes e profissionais de saúde com um sorriso no rosto, garantindo que se sintam bem‑vindos e confortáveis.
  • Vendas Presenciais: Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross‑sell de nossos serviços e produtos, mantendo um foco firme em atingir metas de vendas.
  • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar agendamentos e consultas utilizando sistemas de CRM, assegurando que a clínica funcione de forma eficiente.

  • Ambientação de Profissionais de Saúde: Auxiliar na integração de novos profissionais à clínica, assegurando que estejam confortáveis e preparados para oferecer o melhor atendimento.
  • Gestão de Crises: Lidar com pacientes ou situações desafiadoras de forma calma e eficiente, mantendo a reputação da clínica intacta.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o atendimento presencial e via telefone, seguindo protocolos estabelecidos

title: Standardized Patient
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Job Purpose

The Standardized Patients (SP) are recruited either to simulate medical scenarios or to teach students essential clinical skills. Both roles basic function is to provide professional educational services to teach and assess health sciences learners. Training is mandatory and required to proceed with scheduling. SPs recruited to simulate medical scenarios are expected to portray the case with realism and accuracy. SPs will often be physically examined by students and faculty as part of the learning experience. SPs will recall information, complete a checklist, and provide verbal feedback to learners. SPs will be trained prior to all project participation. If an incumbent is recruited as an SP for teaching sessions, they will teach learners clinical techniques, including but not limited to history-taking, physical examination, communication, empathy, etc. These SPs must complete a rigorous initial training module as well as refresher training prior to all teaching sessions. During teaching sessions, SPs will engage learners by providing them step by step instructions on techniques as well as constructive feedback. SPs will use their body as the teaching tool.

All SP work is supervised by the SP Educator, Administrative Manager, Operations Manager and the Director of Simulation & Clinical Skills. Work hours will vary and are dependent upon course schedules. SPs are permitted a maximum of 58 hours per pay period and are requested to work a minimum of 25 hours per pay period, subject to course needs.

Supervisory Authority

None

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the department and University.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Interest in education and contributing to the development of healthcare professionals
  • Possess a positive and proactive mindset.
  • Simulate all aspects of scenarios, including history of current problem, affect/behavior and physical findings, in a standardized, accurate, and reliable manner.
  • Wear professional clinical attire for work assignments including a hospital gown with only appropriate undergarments, while on camera and/or observed live through an observation window or video monitor.
  • Accurately and consistently complete checklists at a 95% accuracy percentage.
  • Provide verbal feedback to learners using constructive feedback training.
  • Allow and be comfortable with having repeated physical examination maneuvers performed on body by learners and clinical faculty.
  • Accept ongoing feedback from supervisors to incorporate into case simulation.
  • Be willing to be audio and videotaped during simulations (onsite and virtual).
  • Demonstrate flexibility and reliability with work scheduling and assignments.
  • Follow written and verbal instructors from supervisors.
  • Demonstrate core values of professionalism when interacting with learners, faculty, supervisors, and peers.
  • Follow all Center and HU Policies and Procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership
    • Demonstrate professionalism and the ability to accept feedback from supervisors.
    • Demonstrate the ability to maintain diplomacy.
    • Demonstrate strong work ethic.
  • Interpersonal and Communication
    • Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
    • Demonstrate effective positive communication skills in a positive and productive manner with faculty, students, and other users of the Center.
    • Demonstrate the ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the general public.
  • Technical Competency
    • Demonstrate advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
    • Demonstrate skill proficiency at operating computers and associated software applications.
  • Organizational Skills
    • Demonstrate effective organization, and planning skills.
  • Confidentiality
    • Demonstrate the ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Demonstrate excellence in practice

Minimum Requirements

High School diploma or GED equivalent. Must be of legal status to work in the US. Must be computer literate and proficient. Must successfully complete initial HU Introduction to Standardized Methodology workshop for scheduling.

Preferred

  • Experience as an SP.
  • Experience in an academic, healthcare, or simulation learning environment preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $25 - $27 per hour

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division-level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross-org architectural decisions, negotiate trade-offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high-impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1-click insurance products).

Vision and contribution

2026's Vision And (how This Role Contributes). In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data-driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences, (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants, and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations. This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance.

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU).
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue.
  • Insurance launches and scales high-quality one-click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end-state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade-offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co-own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real-time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Drive NuPay ↔ Ads integration for aspirational purchases: real-time underwriting, multi-source funding, take-rate modelling, card-on-file / wallet flows and onboarding for flagship merchants.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one-click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one-stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech-debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post-mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross-BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross-org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share-of-checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one-click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.

Challenges And Opportunities (what You’ll Own)

  • World-class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first-layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real-time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low-latency ads decisioning and NuPay real-time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One-click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one-click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One-Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost-efficient infra.

What You’ll Find In The Team

  • High-calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high-impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real-time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi-partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.

What You’ll Navigate

  • Heavy cross-BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re-architecture or open-scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third-party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade-offs between accelerating one-stack migration and accepting short-term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.
