title: Gerente Jurídico Contencioso, Contratos e Judicial Credit Recovery
description:
Gerente Jurídico Contencioso, Contratos e Judicial Credit Recovery

Job type: Full-time employee

A posição integra o mais alto nível de liderança do departamento jurídico da Tenda, com supervisão direta sobre as frentes de contencioso cível, ambiental, criminal empresarial, administrativo e arbitragens, contratos, recuperação judicial de créditos, marcas e patentes, e regulação de sinistros junto às seguradoras. Atua como elo estratégico entre a liderança executiva e as coordenações e equipes das áreas sob sua responsabilidade.

O escopo desta posição é marcado por quatro vocações complementares e igualmente exigentes. Na frente contenciosa, o profissional lida com volume relevante de ações cíveis, ambientais, criminais empresariais e administrativas, muitas delas de alto impacto reputacional e institucional (ações civis públicas, embargos ambientais, investigações criminais, demandas vinculadas a obras e sinistros, além de arbitragens estratégicas). Na frente contratual, supervisiona a estruturação e revisão de instrumentos de grande complexidade e escala, com interface direta com as áreas de engenharia, suprimentos e comercial. Na recuperação judicial de créditos, lidera a estratégia de recuperação de valores devidos diretamente à Tenda por clientes inadimplentes (parcelas do preço de venda financiadas pela própria companhia, sem intermediação bancária), uma frente com impacto direto no fluxo de caixa da Cia que exige domínio dos instrumentos de cobrança judicial, dos mecanismos de retomada de unidades no âmbito do MCMV e da condução de negociações com devedores e seus representantes. Na gestão de marcas, patentes e sinistros, garante a proteção dos ativos intangíveis da Cia perante o INPI e demais órgãos competentes, e conduz os procedimentos de regulação e acionamento de apólices junto às seguradoras em casos decorrentes das atividades de construção.

A posição exige um líder com visão sistêmica do risco jurídico da Cia, capacidade de gestão simultânea de frentes de natureza muito distinta e habilidade de construir equipes técnicas sólidas em cada uma delas.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar o contencioso cível, ambiental, criminal empresarial, administrativo e arbitral nacional, definindo estratégias de defesa, coordenando escritórios externos parceiros e assegurando consistência técnica e previsibilidade de provisões em casos de alto valor ou impacto reputacional.
  • Liderar a gestão de casos ambientais, criminais e de arbitragem estratégica, conduzindo interlocução direta com o Ministério Público, órgãos reguladores, magistrados, peritos, câmaras arbitrais e escritórios adversos, com autoridade técnica e postura institucional.
  • Supervisionar a área de contratos, garantindo a qualidade jurídica dos instrumentos celebrados pela Cia, a padronização de modelos, o monitoramento de riscos contratuais e o suporte às áreas operacionais e comerciais em negociações relevantes, incluindo a interface com escritórios parceiros especializados em contratos de alta complexidade.
  • Liderar a estratégia de recuperação judicial de créditos devidos diretamente à Tenda, incluindo o acompanhamento de ações de cobrança, os processos de retomada de unidades de mutuários inadimplentes, a gestão da carteira de devedores e a coordenação dos advogados e escritórios externos nessa frente.
  • Gerir os procedimentos administrativos de marcas e patentes perante o INPI e demais órgãos competentes, assegurando a proteção e a regularidade dos ativos de propriedade intelectual da companhia.
  • Gerir os procedimentos de regulação de sinistros junto às seguradoras, conduzindo o acionamento de apólices decorrentes das atividades de construção com rigor técnico, tempestividade e foco na preservação dos direitos securitários da Cia.
  • Representar a Cia em audiências, reuniões com autoridades públicas, instâncias arbitrais e negociações de alto valor, atuando como ponto focal institucional em contextos de alta sensibilidade e visibilidade.
  • Gerir o desempenho das equipes e coordenações sob sua supervisão, com foco no desenvolvimento de lideranças intermediárias, na qualidade técnica das entregas e na construção de um ambiente de alta exigência e alto suporte.
  • Garantir consistência e coesão técnica entre as frentes sob sua gestão, promovendo integração entre os times e uniformidade de posicionamentos jurídicos da companhia.

Qualificações

  • Formação em Direito.
  • Pós-graduação em Direito Civil, Ambiental, Processual, Contratos ou Propriedade Intelectual é diferencial relevante.
  • 12 anos ou mais de experiência jurídica, com ao menos 6 anos em posição de liderança em departamento jurídico corporativo de grande porte ou em escritório de alta reputação com gestão de equipes.
  • Vivência sólida em contencioso cível estratégico, com exposição a matérias ambientais, criminais empresariais, administrativas ou arbitrais.
  • Experiência em recuperação judicial de créditos imobiliários, com domínio dos mecanismos de cobrança, retomada de unidades e negociação com devedores no contexto do MCMV.
  • Experiência na gestão de contratos de grande escala, com interface com áreas operacionais e comerciais.
  • Familiaridade com procedimentos de marcas e patentes perante o INPI e com a gestão de apólices e sinistros junto a seguradoras.
  • Histórico comprovado de interlocução com agentes externos de alto nível: Ministério Público, magistrados, peritos, câmaras arbitrais, escritórios parceiros e adversos em litígios relevantes.

  • Domínio em sistemas de corrente contínua (CC): operação de FCC, NoBreaks e bancos de baterias, assegurando redundância e continuidade de energia;
  • Experiência em dimensionamento e projeto de sistemas elétricos de potência, proteção e seletividade em Média e Baixa Tensão (CA e CC);

  • Experiência em operação e dimensionamento de sistemas de climatização (PLC, Split, Self Contained, Fancoil, Chiller), garantindo eficiência térmica em ambientes críticos;
  • Conhecimento em automação predial e protocolos de comunicação (BMS, redes de monitoramento), com capacidade de análise de alarmes e tendências;
  • Aplicação prática das normas técnicas e regulatórias (NR, NBR, ANSI, TIA, ASHRAE), assegurando compliance e segurança operacional;

description:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst (AI Training)

Identity sits at the heart of modern enterprise security — and at the heart of most major breaches. We're looking for IAM professionals who understand how identity systems fail in the real world to help shape the next generation of AI security reasoning.

At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build and train cutting‑edge AI models. As an IAM Analyst, your hands‑on expertise will be used to evaluate, validate, and improve how AI systems understand identity risk, access control failures, and privilege escalation in realistic enterprise environments.

Job Details

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze real‑world IAM, SSO, and access control scenarios to identify weaknesses and misconfigurations
  • Classify permission issues, privilege‑escalation paths, and identity‑related security failures
  • Review zero‑trust architecture decisions and access design models for correctness and risk
  • Generate and validate realistic identity security data used to train and evaluate AI systems
  • Provide structured expert feedback that directly improves how AI reasons about enterprise identity risk

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of hands‑on experience with IAM, SSO, or enterprise identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Azure AD, AWS IAM, Ping)
  • Solid understanding of RBAC, least‑privilege principles, and access review processes
  • Familiarity with how identity failures occur in practice and how attackers exploit them
  • Able to clearly articulate technical findings in written form
  • Self‑motivated and comfortable working independently on task‑based assignments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with zero‑trust frameworks or identity governance tools
  • Background in cloud IAM (AWS, GCP, Azure) or hybrid identity environments
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK techniques related to credential access and privilege escalation
  • Prior work in security operations, penetration testing, or access control auditing

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside top research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — complete tasks on your own schedule
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
  • Contribute to meaningful work that shapes how AI understands enterprise security
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Senior Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Workforce Strategy & Planning

  • Implement the strategic planning and oversight of Workforce Planning & Operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
  • Lead the end-to-end workforce planning process for the delivery of FWWC2027 to cover all workforce types at FIFA27 (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees etc.)
  • Collaborate closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to develop and manage an integrated workforce planning process, ensuring appropriate and optimized resources to deliver the agreed service levels.
  • Identify & assist with the development of all workforce types and define entitlements for each category.
  • Establish and communicate a centralised headcount plan to serve as the single source of truth for planning and access to data
  • Lead change management processes to support continuity in planning and execution
  • Input into the workforce overall budget, calendar and to the overall workforce strategy

Workforce Operations & Management

  • Deliver and manage the operational plans for all aspects of workforce operations at tournament time, including the design and delivery plan of site operations for workforce
  • Scope all physical operation spaces, overlay, technology and other requirements associated with workforce delivery on site
  • Develop and coordinate business process and scope of requirements for workforce systems to support on site operations at tournament-time
  • Contribute to and deliver the workforce operations role specific and venue specific training
  • Build and manage the schedule for the workforce operations team
  • Collaborate, support and motivate a large team of paid staff and volunteers who will deliver workforce operations on site
  • Collaborate with the wider workforce team on a day-to-day, operational basis
  • Manage logistics and operational requirements at tournament time such as office setup, internal communications, and event-time services (e.g. rewards, certificates, final match celebrations)
  • Coordinate with HR and leadership on sensitive personnel matters
  • Provide guidance and support to workforce operations venue managers at tournament time
  • Draft and communicate policies and procedures to ensure a consistent and positive workforce experience during events
  • Define workforce service levels and contribute to the development of an entitlement’s matrix

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g. Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to prioritise workforce needs
  • Build and maintain strong client focused relationships with all functional areas and work to update and confirm detailed site requirements for all areas.
  • Coordinate with wider workforce, HR and leadership on sensitive personnel matters

Technology & Innovation

  • Provide input into the development and optimisation of Workforce technology tools and platforms
  • Support digital transformation efforts to enhance workforce efficiency and communication

YOUR PROFILE

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of work experience, with at least 2 years in a similar role within workforce planning or operations at an international events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of modern workforce planning systems, tools and practices.
  • Experience in leading operational venue teams at large-scale events
  • Expertise in data and decision making governance related to workforce planning in a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to project manage, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead team members and influence performance through positive leadership techniques.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organisation.

Technology

  • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel)
  • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
  • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

About The Role

What if your security expertise could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems defend themselves against attack? We're looking for AI Security Analysts to stress-test frontier models — probing for vulnerabilities, classifying risks, and helping ensure that cutting-edge AI remains safe, reliable, and resistant to misuse.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for security professionals who are curious about how modern AI systems can be exploited, manipulated, or pushed beyond their intended boundaries. You'll work on real scenarios with real impact — contributing directly to the safety of AI models being deployed at scale.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You\'ll Do

  • Analyze AI and LLM security scenarios to understand how models behave under adversarial or unexpected conditions
  • Review and evaluate cases involving prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse, and system misuse
  • Classify security issues by real-world impact and likelihood, and recommend appropriate mitigations
  • Help evaluate and improve AI system behavior to ensure it remains safe, reliable, and aligned with security best practices
  • Work independently on task-based assignments, fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

  • Background in cybersecurity, information security, or a closely related technical field
  • Strong understanding of modern threat modeling principles applied to emerging AI technologies
  • Familiar with concepts like adversarial prompting, model exploitation, or AI system abuse vectors
  • Naturally analytical and precise — you approach complex systems methodically and think like an attacker
  • Curious about how AI models are built, deployed, and where they break down
  • Clear and concise written communicator who can document findings with precision

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability research
  • Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) or generative AI systems
  • Background in application security, API security, or cloud security
  • Experience with AI safety, alignment research, or responsible AI practices
  • Knowledge of OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar security frameworks

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside leading research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
  • Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact work
  • Be at the forefront of one of the most critical and fast-moving fields in technology
  • Contribute to work that genuinely matters — helping keep powerful AI systems safe at scale
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

Job Overview

We are seeking for Turnaround & Inspection Engineer to join the Riyas NGL Fractionation Maintenance Division (RNGLFMD) of Riyas NGL Fractionation Department (RNGLFD)

RNGLFMD is responsible of two NGL Fractionation trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and Utilities Unit including, but not limited to, Boilers, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Your primary role is to carry out full cycle Turnaround & Inspection (T&I) from planning until final execution and closure. Including cost estimation, scheduling, coordinating with engineering, inspection and operations to identify & finalize the most comprehensive T&I scope of work. Additionally, you will develop detailed job plans for identified T&I scopes and plan all required materials including identification of long lead materials to ensure availability prior to execution date.

Application of Maintenance Engineer when specializing in Digital Maintenance Engineering Performs engineering analysis of real time, process control digital systems in central operations facilities to aid in fault diagnosis.

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols
  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testingAI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

  • You’ve led a team of 4‑8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process

Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How We Work

  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

World-Class Benefits

  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada)
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability supports the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity. This role plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including:
  • Auditing of official FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring improvements to fulfil those requirements are implemented.
  • Working with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Developing and delivering accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.
  • Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:
  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.
  • As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:
  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile – Minimum Requirements

  • A deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • At least 5 years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience of working in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritise effectively, and work independently.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools.

Additional Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations.
  • In‑depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega‑sporting events.
  • Experience developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications experience.
  • Experience working in sports and/or events.
  • International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the tournament and to the assigned host city for the tournament operational period.

description:

Type: Full-time

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo‑banks, fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast‑growing business. With full‑year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass‑consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose‑built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail‑oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM.
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a.
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it.
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape.

What we offer

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child.
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

No agencies. We do not accept CVs from 3rd parties.

title: Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring junior engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation – engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable designing and engineering new software as they are packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Key Teams that Ship Ubuntu

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server: leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop: driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters: a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

Possible categories of work

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

If you have skills in those areas, or you have other skills you believe could contribute to Ubuntu, and you're keen to get started building your career in open source, then this is the role for you. Our junior career path caters for both new graduates and early career engineers.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

The role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go, Python and C/C++
  • Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
  • Debugging issues, then designing and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
  • Continuously learning and progressing their technical and professional skills

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • A passion for open source software
  • Experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Familiarity with Linux distributions
  • Familiarity with system debugging tools and techniques
  • Familiarity with automation tooling and CI/CD systems
  • Experience contributing to open source projects

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Placement Readiness Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
Your Role

At Virtual Internships, we help students worldwide turn potential into opportunity.

As a Placement Readiness Specialist, your mission is to coach and guide interns through the placement matching process with empathy, confidence and warmth.

You’ll thrive here if you love seeing people grow, take pride in measurable impact, and find joy in helping others take their next professional step.

This is a fast-paced, collaborative role where empathy meets accountability and coaching meets operations.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Coaching interns by running mock interviews, giving actionable feedback, and helping them present their best selves.
  • Deliver engaging bootcamp sessions and support interns in developing essential soft skills, and build workplace readiness.
  • Guiding interns through key pre-internship moments by helping them prepare for interviews, make confident decisions, and manage expectations with calm, clear communication.
  • Championing clarity by reinforcing program guidelines, simplifying complex choices, and ensuring every intern keeps moving forward with confidence, while feeling supported.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll see real impact: Every success story starts with you - a career launchpad. The clarity and confidence you build during the placement matching process directly shape interns’ growth and success.
  • You’ll grow fast: Gain hands‑on experience in coaching, education, and program management within a global EdTech startup.
  • You’ll be empowered: We value autonomy and trust you to experiment, learn and own your outcomes.
  • You’ll make a global impact: Your work helps level the playing field for learners around the world.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “Clarity”—you’ll need it later!)

Who We’re Looking For

Your Attributes

  • You own the outcome: You take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and always find a way forward. You see challenges as opportunities to deliver results.
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback early, apply it quickly and share what you learn. You’re humble, curious, and growth‑oriented.
  • You balance accountability with empathy: You understand that support and accountability go hand in hand, creating trust while ensuring progress.
  • You turn complexity into clarity: You simplify, communicate with compassion and close loops so everyone knows next steps.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable across time zones and cultures.

Your Experience

You’ll bring 1–3 years of experience in one or more of these areas, but more importantly, you’ll have stories that show how you’ve helped people move from uncertainty to readiness and potential to performance.

  • Career Services / University Advising: You’ve helped students or graduates prepare for jobs or internships through resume reviews, mock interviews or confidence‑building sessions.
  • Learning & Development / Coaching: You’ve guided individuals or groups through growth, skill‑building or mindset shifts.
  • Program Management / Education Services: You’ve delivered structured, human‑centered programs that balance impact and efficiency.
  • Working in a Remote Environment: You know how to navigate time zones, cultures and asynchronous communication with ease.

You’ll stand out from the crowd if:

  • You’ve coached or mentored students through recruitment or early career programs.
  • You naturally balance empathy with accountability.
  • You get energy from helping others succeed, you’re motivated by progress and transformation.
  • Communicate with warmth and precision, knowing when to challenge and when to reassure.
  • Balance speed with quality. You move fast but you don’t cut corners.

If you’re passionate about helping people grow and love connecting ownership with empathy, we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t tick every box.

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote‑First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch or leave later, it’s totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave: Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your responsibilities are a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby). Therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life‑event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your annual leave.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for a company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

title: Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)
description:
Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .

We have dozens of positions available across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff. These roles will lead documentation efforts within engineering, business operations, or other areas of the company.

The role of a Technical Author

A product-focused Technical Author is a member of a product engineering team, typically focusing on one product or family of products. You will help the team develop documentation that serves users' needs and contribute to the long‑term success of the project.

A customer‑focused Technical Author works with teams such as Field Engineering, Customer Success, or Support, dealing with users of complex software suites in custom configurations. You will take a responsive approach to documentation problems and develop strong technical and contextual knowledge.

An operations‑focused Technical Author is part of a business team (e.g., Legal, HR, or Talent) and maintains internal documentation such as employee handbooks. You will help improve materials relied upon by hundreds of colleagues and define communication patterns for a growing organization.

You will also be part of Canonical’s documentation practice team, working with other Technical Authors to define excellence and drive resources across the company and the open‑source community.

Location

Fully remote roles open to candidates worldwide.

As a Technical Author you will

  • Create, maintain, and improve software and other documentation.
  • Work with team members to help them make effective documentation contributions.
  • Influence the development of Canonical products and services as an expert user with opinions about function and design.
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that the documentation meets their needs.
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation.
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products.
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art at Canonical.
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best practices as part of a disciplinary team.

A strong candidate

  • Is an excellent collaborator and communicator.
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication.
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer’s mindset, or a programmer with a record of excellent documentation.
  • Has a record of community engagement in open‑source software, documentation, research, or related disciplines.
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open‑source communities.
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity and a fascination with software technology.
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight, and enthusiasm.
  • Has experience in software development contexts.
  • Is familiar with Linux, command line, Git, and documentation markup languages such as reStructuredText or MyST.
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent.
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events.

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Deep technical domain knowledge.
  • Open‑source community leadership and management.
  • User‑experience, interaction, or visual design.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide benefits that reflect our values and ideals and meet local needs.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly in‑person team sprints.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management)
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Location

This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.

Role Overview

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high‑performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications. This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high‑quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.

As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members. You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high‑quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues. In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry‑leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock‑solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes‑based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in hackfest events, webinars and conferences.

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Experiência em tratamento de ofensas relacionadas a ataques em infraestrutura, redes e aplicações;
